name: handled soup mug
caption: A handled soup mug with a wide body, a high rim and one large handle. A continuous wall rises from a sealed base; one loop handle joins it. Circular walls keep an even thickness and the handle leaves a real through hole. Overall width is 1.15 times depth; height is 0.80 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous white, blue, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
